files.prompt: Paint a new artwork in exactly the same style as the reference images: 1950s airbrushed space-age advertising illustration, gouache and airbrush on board, bold flat streamline lettering, crisp confident painted shapes, optimistic retro-future, sunny palette of ivory, cream, teal, seafoam, coral, mustard and signal red with chrome highlights. Any people wear sleek space-age couture (fitted, clean lines, chrome accents), never 1950s period dress. Format: a very wide 3:1 panoramic billboard, full bleed, the main subject large and balanced left to right, the lettering large and clear of the edges. Subject: Holidays on the Moon: a chrome-and-coral rocket liner landed beside a glass-domed lunar resort with a swimming pool and palm trees under the dome, the blue Earth rising large in a deep teal sky, a smiling couple in white space-age resort wear waving from a curved terrace. The only lettering is the words "FLY TO LUNA" in huge bold streamline capitals, spelled exactly; no other text anywhere. The flat artwork itself, straight-on, filling the whole canvas edge to edge: no margins, no billboard structure, no frame, no border, no mockup, not a photograph. No real brands, no logos, no trademarks, no watermark, no signature, no small print.
files.postprocess: signage_art.py cells_b: centre-crop to the cell aspect, Lanczos to the cell size (ad 1024x341, poster 456x684)
